question: In which of the following years was the Central Vigilance Commission set up by the Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1964**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Central Vigilance Commission (CVC) was set up by the Government of India in **1964**.
 
• The establishment of the CVC was recommended by the Committee on Prevention of Corruption, headed by K. Santhanam.
 
• The CVC was initially created to address governmental corruption and to oversee vigilance activities in various organizations under the central government.
 
• It operates independently of any executive authority, ensuring its autonomy in functioning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Role and Functions**:

 
 
• The CVC supervises the vigilance activities of the Central Government and its organizations.
 
• It advises various authorities in central government organizations on vigilance matters and on planning, executing, reviewing, and reforming their vigilance work.
 
 
 
• **Amendments and Empowerment**:
 
 
• The Central Vigilance Commission Act was enacted in 2003, which provided statutory status to the CVC.
 
• This Act empowers the CVC to exercise superintendence over the functioning of the Delhi Special Police Establishment (CBI) for investigation of offenses under the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988.
 
 
 
• **Appointment and Composition**:
 
 
• The CVC is headed by a Central Vigilance Commissioner and can have up to two Vigilance Commissioners.
 
• The appointment of the Commissioners is done by the President of India based on the recommendations of a committee consisting of the Prime Minister, Minister of Home Affairs, and the Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha.
 
 
 
• **Recent Developments**:
 
 
• In recent years, the CVC has been focusing on leveraging technology to enhance transparency and efficiency in its operations.
 
• It has introduced various initiatives such as the Integrity Index and e-pledge to promote a culture of integrity and accountability.
